first mobile agent app, NPS and CES in service levels, and who each scheduled report reached.

Mobile agent app: agents can work from an Android phone or tablet. They sign in, pick their organisation, set their status and breaks, and take and make calls, with speaker, hold, a live call-quality signal and the call outcome step. A work list shows their callbacks, leads and tickets, and what they do offline is sent when they are back online. The app locks with a PIN and warns on a rooted phone. Admins enrol phones with a QR code from Get the apps and manage them on a new Devices page. They can set the hours mobile agents work, after which those agents are not offered calls, and approve overtime requests. When a call comes in, a mobile agent's phone is woken, and the organisation can choose to ring the agent's own cell number if the app does not answer (off unless switched on). Agents who work only at a desk are not affected. The help guide and an Academy lesson cover the Devices page.

Service levels, NPS and CES: a survey question can be scored as CSAT, NPS or CES, and service levels show the NPS and CES score and how many responded, by queue or campaign.

Scheduled reports, deliveries: each scheduled report shows who its last run reached, and whether each recipient was sent the report or it failed.

Fixes: a maintenance announcement names the time zone in force on the day of the work (a June window no longer says Greenwich Mean Time after the clocks change); leaving a Partner Academy practice organisation now removes the learner's practice sign-in reliably, retrying later if the first try fails."}
